description: This file defines the AttendanceServiceException class, which extends the base Exception class to provide specific error messages related to attendance operations such as punch in/out overlaps, invalid times, and missing data.

classes.name: AttendanceServiceException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling specific attendance service errors in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: punchOutAlreadyExist
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that a punch out already exists for the employee.

methods.name: punchInAlreadyExist
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that a punch in already exists for the employee.

methods.name: punchOutTimeBehindThanPunchInTime
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that punch out time is before punch in time.

methods.name: punchInOverlapFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating an overlap in punch-in times.

methods.name: punchOutOverlapFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating an overlap in punch-out times.

methods.name: invalidDateTime
methods.description: Creates an exception for invalid date and time inputs.

methods.name: punchOutDateTimeNull
methods.description: Creates an exception when punch out date and time are null.

methods.name: deletableAttendanceRecordIdsEmpty
methods.description: Creates an exception when no attendance record IDs are provided for deletion.

methods.name: invalidTimezoneDetails
methods.description: Creates an exception for invalid timezone offset or name.
